calculatePlatformInterest(BassetPersonal.details: Calculates the gains accrued across all lending markets.

migrateBassets(BassetPersonal[] storage,.details: Transfers all collateral from one lending market to another - used initially      to handle the migration between Aave V1 and Aave V2. Note - only supports non      tx fee enabled assets. Supports going from no integration to integration, but      not the other way around.

params._bAssets: Array of basket assets to migrate
params._newIntegration: Address of the new platform integration

startRampA(AmpData storage,uint256,uint2.details: Starts changing of the amplification var A

params._rampEndTime: Time at which A will arrive at _targetA

stopRampA(AmpData storage,uint256).details: Stops the changing of the amplification var A, setting it to whatever the current value is.
